name: Boot-window check-in, then Bluetooth: heap during the window, cancellation before Bluetooth, restart-first after Bluetooth, and (measure only) Bluetooth after a finished check with the restart skipped
reviewer_setup: Needs a local_test build, saved WiFi settings, and a linked device whose `cloud base` points at a LAN test-mode site (see wifi-pull.json for the site recipe; `cloud token` with a linked credential is enough). Automatic check-ins must be on (no `upd.policy=never`) and the battery must read VBAT >= 3.6 V and SOC >= 20 %, or the boot window reports skip=low-battery. The site spaces check-ins 60 s apart, so the case waits between boots. Run python test/bench/cf_replay.py test/bench/cases/t392-boot-window-bt-after.json --port <PORT>. Part 1 records the boot-window check (join, total, internal heap minimum and smallest largest block while the Bluetooth controller is still idle) and shows that the Music Player then starts only after a restart. Part 2 launches the Music Player while the boot-window check is still running and asserts the check ends (cancelled) and is logged before the restart that precedes any Bluetooth start. Part 3 asks for a check after Bluetooth was used and asserts the restart-first path. Part 4 is a measurement for the Bluetooth-after-WiFi question: a test-only switch skips the restart, and the case records whether Bluetooth still starts (controller and host enabled, scan screen) and the heap. Part 4 never changes release behaviour.

steps.matches: \[checkin\] reason=boot join_ms=[1-9][0-9]* total_ms=[0-9]+ result=(ok|none) err=(none|report-deferred) heap_min=[0-9]+ largest_min=[0-9]+ wifi=off
\[checkin\] reason=recovery join_ms=[1-9][0-9]* total_ms=[0-9]+ result=(ok|none) err=none heap_min=[0-9]+ largest_min=[0-9]+ wifi=off
